findings.summary: The universal external-ID field set requires pullRequest, pullRequests, checkSha, and provenanceReceiptSha256, but the merge-group manifest representation contains only components and explicitly prohibits pullRequest, checkSha, and provenanceReceiptSha256. Neither the policy nor runtime schema defines the derived merge-group external-ID object or binds its required pullRequests/checkSha values to components/headSha. A consumer can therefore implement this required external-ID binding ambiguously

candidateManifest has no required version field, although the immutable policy declares manifest version 1. The runtime contract consequently cannot distinguish or reject an instance from a different manifest format; the regression test validates only the policy’s top-level frozen constants and does not cover this mismatch.
